# Default premount duration in seconds<AvailableFrom v="4.0.535" />

Set the default premount duration in seconds for timed components in the Studio. Defaults to 2. Before v4.0.535, there was no premounting by default.

## CLI flag

```text
--default-premount-in-seconds <value>
```

The following CLI commands accept this option:

- [`remotion studio`](/docs/cli/studio)

## Config file

```ts twoslash title="remotion.config.ts"
import {Config} from '@remotion/cli/config';
// ---cut---
Config.setDefaultPremountInSeconds(2);
```
